title: HomeGuard Claims Manual: Voided Payments, Closing and Reopening a Claim
content:
## Voiding a claim payment

A HomeGuard Homeowners Policy claim payment is voided only when it has not been cashed and must be reissued, for one of these reasons:

- a payee correction after a mortgagee is added or removed;
- a lost check; or
- a check left uncashed 180 days after issue.

A void always reverses one payment entry in full, and the void names the payment it reverses. A payment that has already been voided is never voided again.

The replacement is a new claim payment of the reissue kind, for the same coverage part, property class and amount as the voided payment, dated the void date.

| Situation of the payment | Void permitted |
|---|---|
| Uncashed, payee must change because a mortgagee was added or removed | Yes |
| Uncashed, check reported lost | Yes |
| Uncashed 180 days after issue | Yes |
| Already voided | No |

*Hypothetical example.* A dwelling payment of 4200 USD issued to the insured alone is still uncashed when a mortgagee is added. It is voided for 4200 USD, and a reissue payment of 4200 USD for the same coverage part and property class is dated the void date.

## Closing a claim

A claim is closed when every reported coverage part has been paid or denied and no holdback on it remains. A claim with holdback remaining stays open until that holdback is released or forfeited.

## Reopening a closed claim

A closed claim is reopened for supplemental damage from the same occurrence only when the request is made no later than the reopen window that starts on the date the claim was closed.

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Date the window starts from | The closing date recorded on the claim file |
| Unit | Calendar days |
| Last day | The closing date plus 365 days |
| Request made on the last day | Within the window |
| Later request for the same occurrence | Declined |

Damage from a new occurrence is not a reopening; it is a new claim.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical).* A request for further damage from the same occurrence made on the closing date plus 365 days reopens the claim. The same request made one day later is declined.
